name: daibilet
description: Дайбилет — агрегатор билетов на экскурсии, музеи и мероприятия по городам РФ

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,admin,supplier -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "corepack pnpm dev:backend" "corepack pnpm dev:frontend" "corepack pnpm dev:admin" "corepack pnpm dev:supplier"
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @daibilet/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @daibilet/backend build && corepack pnpm --filter @daibilet/frontend build
scripts.db:generate: echo "Error: run this command from packages/backend (pnpm --filter @daibilet/backend db:generate)" && exit 1
scripts.db:migrate: echo "Error: run this command from packages/backend (pnpm --filter @daibilet/backend db:migrate)" && exit 1
scripts.db:seed: echo "Error: run this command from packages/backend (pnpm --filter @daibilet/backend db:seed)" && exit 1
scripts.db:studio: echo "Error: run this command from packages/backend (pnpm --filter @daibilet/backend db:studio)" && exit 1
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @daibilet/backend exec tsc --noEmit && corepack pnpm --filter @daibilet/frontend exec tsc --noEmit
